# Tsarbomba

> > Tsarbomba is a luxury watch manufacturer specializing in automatic and mechanical timepieces featuring Swiss and Japanese movements, premium materials like titanium, ceramic, and sapphire crystal, and innovative modular designs.

The brand offers distinctive collections including the Elemental, Atomic, Dark Matter, Neutron, and Nucleus Femme series, with customizable and interchangeable components. Tsarbomba watches combine technical precision with bold aesthetics, utilizing movements from Miyota, Seiko, and Epson, housed in cases crafted from 316L stainless steel, ceramic, and titanium.

## Key Topics

- Automatic watches
- Miyota movement
- Elemental Series
- Atomic Series
- Sapphire crystal
- 316L stainless steel
- Titanium watches
- Ceramic watches
- Skeleton watches
- Interchangeable straps
- Swiss automatic movements
- Waterproof watches (20 Bar)
- Deployant clasp
- Women's luxury timepieces
- Limited edition collections
